# Hammer & Mold

> An auction house for original vintage toys. Sellers upload photos; our AI identifies, dates, grades and validates each toy; buyers bid. Kenner Star Wars, The Real Ghostbusters, Japanese kaiju and more. Worldwide, insured.

Hammer & Mold is a curated, auction-first marketplace for genuine vintage collectible toys, based in the Netherlands. Every lot is identified, condition-graded and told: the toy, the maker, and the story behind it. Only genuine collectibles are accepted; prohibited or non-toy items are rejected automatically.

## How it works
- Sellers upload a few clear photos, including a close-up of the maker's stamp (moulded year, country and factory markings).
- AI curation writes the listing, dates the year and line, grades condition, flags variants and proposes a fair starting bid.
- Lots run as live auctions with bidding, hidden reserves, anti-snipe extension and Buy-now. Buyers pay securely; sellers ship worldwide, insured. Buyers can review sellers after a purchase.

## The Empires (makers)
- Kenner (Cincinnati) — Star Wars, The Real Ghostbusters
- Japanese kaiju makers — Bullmark, Marusan, Popy
- Each maker has its own documentary page; each toy links back to its Empire.

## Seller plans
- Starter (free): 3 listing tokens per month, 15% commission on sold lots, AI curation and validation.
- Premium (paid membership): 50 listing tokens per month with rollover, 10% commission, featured placement. Early-bird pricing for the first six months.
- One token = one listing. Extra token packs can be bought at any time.

## Launch
- The public auctions open on 1 September 2026. Before then, lots appear in Preview and early sign-ups are welcome.
